title: People Manager
description:
Position Summary
Reporting to the People Director LATAM and dotted to the General Manager (GM) of Brasil, this role will strengthen the People function in Brasil as a trusted business partner and advisor who provides value and contributes to the achievement of business outcomes. This position will provide support to the GM of Brasil and to the respective Leadership Team. It will manage all People activities and processes in alignment with the Three-Year Strategic Plan (3YSP) and blend local and global People practices in a seamless plan communicated clearly to the organization and executed within the defined timelines.


Summary of Accountabilities
This position involves working closely with the People Director for Latin America and the General Manager (GM) of Brasil to develop an HR Strategy for Brasil that aligns with the global People strategic plan and supports the business in achieving its Three-Year Strategic Plan (3YSP). This position is responsible for executing all global and local people related processes and projects, such as performance, talent management, culture, engagement, and organization effectiveness, as well as recruitment, onboarding, talent retention, stakeholder management, and all projects that support Brasil business goals. This position will integrate these global and local activities into a single plan and communicate the plan to the organization. This position will also be a great networker and build relationships with key and critical stakeholders of Brasil.


Key Accountabilities

  • Leadership Team member: brings People perspective to the table as part of Brasil and Leadership Team.
  • Business advisor: provides credible and trusted advice and guidance to the business.
  • People coaching and consulting: supports Brasil with PEOPLE coaching and consulting.
  • Talent resourcing and workforce planning: designs strategic plans for talent sourcing, development, and retention.
  • Organization and technical capabilities: identifies and defines capabilities with the business to drive results.
  • Stakeholder relationships: maintains ongoing dialogue and builds positive and long-term relationships with different stakeholders and their teams to understand their business challenges and opportunities and leverage PEOPLE solutions and interventions as needed.
  • Integrated Talent Strategy: ensures that Brasil has the right talent, at the right time for the right positions with special emphasis on development and retention. In coordination with the GM and the leadership team:
  • Talent acquisition: selects, interviews, recruits, and onboard top talent in the marketplace with the support of external vendors.
  • Talent development: conducts a Learning Need Analysis and defines & implements a country specific development plan leveraging internal and external resources that will build capability across the organization and raise the bar in individual performance.
  • Talent management: deploys the Global Talent Management process to identify key and emerging talent, and designs programs to develop and retain our high potentials.
  • Global People Solutions co-design: co-designs Global People Solutions with the Global PEOPLE Team.
  • People Systems and tools: leverages enterprise People Systems and tools that support the implementation of processes providing relevant and timely metrics that monitor performance.
  • People communication: ensures Brasil receives frequent updates on the work the People function is progressing forward, leveraging all internal communication channels: meetings, email, the intranet and creating new ones if needed.
  • Werfen Ambassador: raises awareness of Werfen in Brasil by delivering presentations that socialize the brand and Werfen’s business agenda across universities, consultancy companies, candidates, etc.

Skills & Capabilities

  • People skills: enjoys and excels at engaging with people both formally and informally. Is trustworthy, reliable, and engaged.
  • Stakeholder management: handles different stakeholders with diverse agendas and backgrounds effectively.
  • Matrix working: thrives in the added complexity of dual reporting relationship: business and PEOPLE.
  • Impact and influence: persuades a diverse variety of audiences successfully.
  • Project management: sets realistic objectives, plans accordingly, and meets deadlines confidently.
  • Communication skills: presents, facilitates short workshops, develops materials and toolkits proficiently.
  • Framework understanding: connects different pieces of work and feels comfortable entering data into a system.
  • Stress management: remains calm and composed under difficult situations and juggles a wide range of activities, tasks, and projects efficiently.
  • Strategy and operations balance: balances between strategic and PEOPLE operational day to day work.
  • Prioritization skills: prioritizes and differentiates urgent activities from important ones effectively.

Multi-cultural working relationship: works with a variety of different people from different backgrounds and perspectives harmoniously.

Minimum 6-8 years of work experience in People dept.
Has min experience of 2-3 years as a People Consultant or Specialist.

Knowledge of People frameworks (culture, engagement, organization effectiveness, learning & development, talent) and People sub-functions: C&B, recruitment, labour relations, etc.

Se você sempre sonhou em trabalhar em uma das empresas que mais emprega no Brasil, que está em constante transformação e investe em projetos de inovação, essa é sua chance!

Nosso maior desafio é promover e liderar a transformação do modelo de operação e manutenção de redes de Telecom, aportando tecnologia, revisando procedimentos, otimizando recursos e, principalmente, investindo na capacitação e no desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores. Sua missão será:

Se interessou? Venha trabalhar em uma empresa que conecta pessoas!

  • Requisitar, receber e conferir materiais e equipamentos (recebimento/coleta), vistoriando-os e verificando documentos, a fim de certificar a conformidade aos pedidos efetuados;

  • Realizar içamento e fixação de painéis solares e equipamentos, projetar, vistoriar e transportar materiais e equipamentos;

description:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!

As a Bid Ops Optimization Engineer working on the Publisher Professional Services team in São Paulo, you will be responsible to proactively identifying optimization opportunities via complex data sets, conducting configurations necessary to improve performance, managing support/ break fix escalations, and working closely with Account Managers, RnD and Product to scale and support activity.

Note internally this title will be called Bid Ops Optimization Engineer.

To thrive in this role, you'll need:
  • 3+ years of experience in a sales engineering, 3rd level support, technical account management or similar role within the AdTech industry
  • Solid understanding of web front-end technologies including JSON, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Demonstrated success in leveraging data trends to identify opportunities and formulate actionable strategies for performance enhancement
  • Ability to monitor and resolve technical issues with existing integrations. Advanced troubleshooting capabilities, including diagnosing and resolving technical bidder issues.
  • Proficiency in SQL and extracting and analyzing data from databases to derive insights.
  • Exceptional communication skills in English, both verbal and written

Nice to haves include:

  • Experience with programmatic and ad tech serving platforms
  • Familiarity with running A/B tests and web analytics programs
  • Knowledge of Business Intelligence (BI) tools
  • Background or experience in UX
  • Client facing experience
How you’ll make an impact:

As a Bid Ops Optimization Engineer, you’ll bring value by:

  • Managing day-to-day ad operations tasks: proactively explore data, dashboards and conduct and ensure account health checks to discover opportunities to optimize and improve our publishers' performance.
  • Identifying novel optimization opportunities and implement them into a systematic daily workflow.
  • Leading the development and execution of AB testing and optimization initiatives across all business units.
  • Acting as a subject matter expert and escalation point for issues as they arise from our business teams across the globe.
  • Utilizing data and research from various sources to establish testing parameters and interpret test outcomes.
  • Translating qualitative and quantitative test results into actionable business insights and relay them to Account manager and clients.
  • Working in a diverse global team towards optimizing existing and new accounts: Conversing daily with Account managers, Product RnD and directly with clients

  • Supporting the complex alerts, and perform in-depth troubleshooting including DB analysis and reading system logs to identify and solve issues that were escalated by the 1st level monitoring support team
  • Sharing the knowledge - Write technical notes and troubleshooting procedures to be used by the entire support organization
Why Taboola?

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:

  • Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.
  • Well-being : Taboola São Paulo offers a generous benefit package including health insurance.
  • Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office with an option to come in more often if desired.
  • Work with some of the biggest names: We work with some of the biggest names in the business. Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, Expedia and Honda.

Ready to realize your potential?

Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn , Facebook , Instagram , X , YouTube , & the Taboola Life Blog .

About Taboola

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.

Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

title: Confira 5 técnicas de limpeza profissional para ambientes comerciais
description:
Manter um ambiente limpo e higiênico é fundamental para a saúde e o bem-estar de todos. No entanto, muitas vezes a limpeza pode ser um desafio, especialmente quando se trata de grandes áreas ou superfícies delicadas. Pensando nisso, aqui estão algumas dicas e técnicas profissionais que podem ajudar a manter um ambiente limpo e higiênico:

Dica 01: Comece de cima para baixo
A limpeza deve começar pelas áreas mais altas, como tetos, paredes e luminárias, para evitar que a sujeira caia nas áreas já limpas. Isso garante que o processo de limpeza seja mais eficiente e minimize o risco de contaminação cruzada.

Dica 02: Usar panos de cores diferentes
Uma prática simples, mas eficaz, para evitar a contaminação cruzada. Isso garante que os panos utilizados em áreas de alta circulação ou com alto risco de contaminação não sejam utilizados em áreas mais sensíveis ou críticas. Por exemplo, panos vermelhos podem ser utilizados em áreas de banheiro, enquanto panos azuis podem ser utilizados em áreas de cozinha.

Dica 03: Ventilar os ambientes
Garantir que as superfícies estejam bem secas após a limpeza é fundamental para prevenir o desenvolvimento de fungos e bactérias. Isso é especialmente importante em áreas úmidas, como banheiros e cozinhas, onde a umidade pode criar um ambiente propício para o crescimento de microorganismos. Além disso, também ajuda a prevenir a formação de manchas e marcas.

Dica 04: Estabelecer um Cronograma de Limpeza
Isso inclui definir tarefas de limpeza regulares, como varrer, limpar superfícies e esvaziar lixeiras, e garantir que essas tarefas sejam realizadas de forma consistente. Além disso, manter a organização em áreas de maior tráfego, como entradas e corredores, ajuda a prevenir a acumulação de sujeira e objetos desnecessários.

Dica 05: Utilize equipamentos profissionais
A utilização de equipamentos profissionais, como mop pulse e microfibra, pode tornar a limpeza mais rápida e eficiente. Além disso, a limpeza mecanizada com lavadoras a bateria e robôs pode ser uma solução eficaz para grandes áreas. A limpeza a seco também é uma opção que reduz o consumo de água e minimiza o impacto ambiental.

O que dizem os especialistas?
“A limpeza profissional é fundamental para manter a saúde e a segurança nos ambientes comerciais. Com as técnicas e equipamentos certos, é possível garantir uma limpeza eficaz e sustentável, minimizando o impacto ambiental e reduzindo os custos”, destaca Francisco Pimentel, gerente de Qualidade da Jan-Pro de Manaus.

Com essas dicas e técnicas profissionais, é possível manter um ambiente limpo, higiênico e sustentável. Além disso, a utilização de equipamentos e produtos adequados pode tornar o processo de limpeza mais eficiente e minimizar o impacto ambiental.

“A limpeza profissional é uma arte que exige conhecimento, habilidades e equipamentos adequados. Com as técnicas certas, é possível garantir que os ambientes sejam mantidos limpos e higiênicos, minimizando o risco de doenças e melhorando a qualidade de vida dos ocupantes”, aponta Fernanda Mamud, gerente regional da JAN-PRO de Manaus.

Sobre a JAN-PRO
A JAN-PRO é líder mundial em serviços de limpeza comercial e desinfecção de ambientes, com mais de 30 anos de atuação no mercado e presença em 11 países. Reconhecida pela sua excelência, a JAN-PRO oferece soluções de limpeza que garantem ganhos de produtividade, qualidade, redução de custos e responsabilidade ambiental. Especializada em limpeza corporativa, hospitalar e profissional, a empresa combina ciência e tecnologia para proporcionar ambientes limpos e seguros. Recomendada para limpeza comercial, a JAN-PRO é uma marca de confiança que se destaca pela inovação e eficiência em suas operações.

description:
Gerente de Operações Noturno (Curitiba - PR), Amazon Logistics

Job ID: 2938511 | Amazon Logistica do Brasil

A equipe da Amazon Logística está em busca de um(a) Gerente de Operações para se juntar à equipe da AMZL Brasil.

Como Gerente de Operações, você será responsável pela operação em uma Estação de Entrega, fornecendo liderança para Líderes de Equipe, Operadores e Prestadores de Serviços de Entrega, gerenciando relacionamentos e desempenho de agências externas. Você trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais semelhante a uma start-up do que a uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Se você tem um histórico focado na qualidade e obcecado pelo cliente, que carrega consigo a experiência de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, em constante mudança e ambíguo, adoraríamos ouvir sua opinião.

A função envolve:

  1. Estar baseado em um de nossos postos de entrega. A Amazon opera 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, portanto, o trabalho em turnos fará parte dessa função, incluindo noites, finais de semana e feriados.
  2. Supervisão da operação que foca na entrega de pedidos da Amazon direto aos clientes.
  3. Apoiar sua equipe de líderes operacionais na gestão diária do posto de entrega. Isso incluirá alocação de mão de obra, liderança de reuniões, atribuição de tarefas e comunicação com fornecedores internos e externos.
  4. Trabalhar com KPIs como On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success e melhorar o atendimento ao cliente.
  5. Pensar analiticamente sobre gerenciamento de projetos com atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de influenciar os outros e habilidades organizacionais excepcionais.
  6. Ser obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para gerar melhorias.
  7. Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal. Utilizando habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas e comunicação para influenciar o público comercial e técnico.
  8. Fornecer suporte diário durante a implantação/implementação de novos sistemas/processos e coletar feedback.
  9. Mapeamento de requisitos de negócios, entendimento de processos de negócios, estudo e análise de fluxos de trabalho e desenho de soluções.
  10. Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham as ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  11. Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos de Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência em Operações de segmentos como Logística, Manufatura, Indústria geral e áreas afins;
  • Experiencia com gestão de pessoas;
  • MS Office, com nível intermediário em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no período da noite (23hs - 10hs) e em turnos flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana e feriados;
  • Inglês intermediário e Português fluente;
  • Experiencia em E-commerce;
  • Conhecimentos em gestão de projetos ou de processos.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a entregar os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Se você tem uma deficiência e precisa de uma acomodação ou ajuste no local de trabalho durante o processo de aplicação e contratação, incluindo suporte para a entrevista ou processo de integração, visite este link para mais informações. Responsibilities and assignments
Como Pessoa Coordenador de Operações- CD Fisia você entrará em campo, com as seguintes atividades:

  • Disseminar cultura de segurança para o time de liderança e garantir que o tema de segurança esteja sempre em primeiro lugar.
  • Receber e analisar a demanda diária: O coordenador deve receber e analisar as demandas de forma precisa, considerando os volumes de produtos a serem movimentados, e elaborar estratégias eficientes de divisão de tarefas entre sua equipe.
  • Preparação da equipe: Certifique-se de que todos os seus atletas estejam devidamente preparados para executar suas rotinas de trabalho. Isso inclui fornecer os insumos, equipamentos e EPIs necessários, bem como oferecer treinamentos para que todos compreendam e dominem os processos operacionais.
  • Treinamento da equipe: Além de preparar a equipe para suas atividades, o coordenador deve investir no treinamento contínuo dos colaboradores, capacitando-os em habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, buscando o aprimoramento profissional.
  • Garantir que o Programa 5S seja aplicado e mantido em sua área, promovendo a organização, limpeza, padronização e disciplina, o que contribui para a eficiência operacional.
  • Atuar na redução de custos operacionais: Propor melhorias nos processos produtivos que buscam a redução de custos operacionais, sem comprometer a qualidade dos serviços prestados ou a segurança dos colaboradores.
  • Análise de desvios: Utilizando ferramentas como A3, PDCA, Kaizen entre outras metodologias para analisar e propor soluções para os desvios de produção, buscando a otimização dos processos.
  • Cumprimento dos KPIs: Garantir que todos os indicadores-chave de desempenho da área sejam atendidos conforme acordado com a gestão, como SLA CD LF, SLA Digital, OTIF, entre outros.
  • Desenvolvimento da equipe: Contribuir para o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional de sua equipe, incentivando a aplicação dos valores da empresa e aprimorando as competências dos colaboradores.
  • Desenvolver sucessores: Desenvolver supervisores para plano de sucessão e perenidade do negócio.
  • Garantir a qualidade das operações: Assegurar que todos os pedidos sejam separados corretamente, no tempo certo e com qualidade adequada, tanto para clientes externos (Digital) quanto para clientes internos (LF).
  • Zelar pelos estoques: Garantir que os estoques dos Centros de Distribuição estejam corretos, com os produtos alocados na quantidade e local adequados, evitando falhas no abastecimento.
  • Ao cumprir suas responsabilidades, o Coordenador de Operações contribuirá para o sucesso do centro de distribuição, otimizando custos, mantendo a qualidade dos serviços e promovendo um ambiente de trabalho seguro e produtivo para toda a equipe.

Na Shopee, acreditamos que cada membro de nossa equipe é fundamental para o nosso sucesso, e que diversidade de perspectivas e vivências são essenciais para movimentar nosso negócio e impulsionar nosso propósito de mudar o mundo para melhor. Modelo de Trabalho

Adotamos um modelo de trabalho híbrido, que permite que as pessoas ajustem seu ambiente de trabalho de acordo com suas necessidades pessoais, promovendo colaboração e interação no escritório.

Qual será a sua missão

Buscamos uma pessoa para assumir a posição de Product Manager , liderando o desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções digitais voltadas para nossos vendedores no modelo Fulfillment. Sua principal missão será compreender profundamente as necessidades dos vendedores e das operações logísticas, traduzindo essas demandas em requisitos claros de produto e alinhando com os objetivos estratégicos do negócio.   1. Conhecer e se aprofundar na jornada do vendedor;
  2. Entender oportunidades de melhoria dos produtos existentes;
  3. Compreender operações de galpão e fiscais para navegar em discussões com a área de negócio;
  4. Traduzir requisitos de negócio (seller, operacionais e fiscais) em requisitos de produto;
  5. Colaborar com equipes regionais e locais para melhorar usabilidade, funcionalidade e desenvolvimento dos produtos digitais;

  4. Inglês avançado (será testado durante o processo de seleção);

  • Experiência na Área Rural: Conhecimento em manejo de gado, incluindo separação de animais, cuidados diários, identificação de doenças, controle de alimentação e bem-estar.

Suas responsabilidades incluirão a execução de atividades e demandas da área, garantindo o cumprimento de processos e rotinas, sendo ponto focal para todas as iniciativas relacionadas às mídias sociais. Além disso, será responsável por promover a divulgação de produtos, serviços, imagem de marca e empresa, campanhas e conteúdo editorial.

Suas Principais Responsabilidades e Atividades Serão

  • Planejar, criar e executar calendário editorial de postagens da marca
  • Gerenciar as páginas e perfis corporativos em todas as mídias sociais que a marca atua

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ?

  • Ensino superior, formado em Marketing, Comunicação Social, Publicidade ou Jornalismo
  • Experiência com atuação na área de marketing e comunicação, com foco em gestão de mídias sociais e marketing de influência
  • Entendimento sobre Buyer Persona para construção de pautas e conteúdos digitais
  • Noções claras de redação publicitária, briefings e roteiros
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de gestão de redes sociais, se houver experiência em Mlabs será um diferencial
  • Conhecimento e experiência em criação e produção de conteúdos
  • Conhecimento profundo das principais métricas de redes sociais como taxa de engajamento, alcance, crescimento do perfil, fluxo para o ecommerce e demais KPI’s

O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR NA R.BRANDS?

  • Benefício flexível no Cartão Caju no valor de R$30,00 por dia útil (sem descontos)
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível (sem descontos)
  • Café da manhã e da tarde em cozinhas equipadas

  • Assistência odontológica
  • Descontos exclusivos nos produtos das nossas marcas
  • Kit Boas-vindas entregue no início do nosso onboarding
  • Convênio SESC e CDL, com diversas vantagens em viagens, eventos culturais, projetos na área de lazer e esporte, utilização de serviços de saúde, cursos, formações e atividades educativas, além de descontos em várias empresas parceiras
  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo e crescimento interno

  • Cultura voltada à inovação e ao empreendedorismo

Horário De Trabalho
Presencial, de segunda à quinta-feira, das 08h às 18h, e sexta-feira das 8h às 17h, com 1 hora de intervalo.
Vaga para atuação no Pedra Branca, em Palhoça/SC.

QUEM SOMOS E QUAL O NOSSO PROPÓSITO?
Criada para abrigar marcas que atuam de forma independente umas das outras, a R.brands é uma house of brands , ou seja, uma casa de marcas que serve para abraçar diversas outras, cada uma com suas próprias características e DNA. A nova identidade assume uma essência mais dinâmica, estratégica e conectada com o novo momento da empresa.

Como house of brands , nosso foco é desenvolver e gerir marcas de estilo de vida baseado em atividade, que conectem, inspirem e emocionem. Nosso propósito? Inspirar e habilitar pessoas a serem a melhor versão de si mesmas.

Nosso nome, R.brands, vem do termo _r.evolution_, que reúne em si referências à revolução que estamos construindo e à evolução que estamos vivenciando. Por aqui, uma grande transformação está acontecendo e o ponto presente no nosso nome não é um ponto final, mas sim um novo ponto de partida.

Atualmente, trabalhamos com 3 marcas: INVICTUS e BR FORCE, no segmento tático, e GALAPAGOS, no segmento outdoor. Cada uma delas possui objetivos específicos e personalidade própria, porém, são alinhadas ao propósito do grupo, permitindo, assim, uma atuação sinérgica e ampla.

Temos um ambiente voltado para alta performance, aprendizado, inovação e levamos muito a sério nossos valores: Integridade, Autorresponsabilidade, Obstinação, Inconformismo, Coragem e Empatia. Eles resumem como as coisas funcionam por aqui e, também, nosso jeito de ser. E aí, se identificou com a R.brands e se acha pronto para encarar esta r.evolução?

title: Programme Coordinator
description:
Wars and armed conflicts come to an end; however, the remnants of war continue to impact millions of people for decades to follow. Mine Action and Disarmament’s vision is a world where people and communities are safe, resilient and protected before, during and after armed conflict. Together with national authorities and other stakeholders, we are working to resolve problems faced by local communities caused by Explosive Ordnance (EO). Currently, NPA has more than 20 Mine Action Programmes ongoing in Africa, Asia, Latin America, South East Europe and the Middle East.

Do you want to play a key role in one of the largest and most complex programmes in Norwegian People’s Aid? Are you great at collaborating and communicating with different stakeholders and an excellent organizer? Do you have experience in working successfully with multiple donors in a fast-paced environment? We are looking for our new Programme Coordinator in Iraq!

Location: Baghdad, Iraq

We offer:

  • Responsibility in our Flagship Programme: Work closely with our senior management team in one of NPA’s largest and most intricate country programmes in Iraq, renowned for its impact and breadth.
  • Rewarding Compensation: We offer a comprehensive salary package, inclusive of specific allowances for the region and a robust insurance scheme.
  • Work life balance: Benefit from our R&R scheme and enjoy five weeks of annual holiday, plus an additional week for expatriates.
  • Career Longevity: This is a two-year contract position with potential for renewal, under the Norwegian Working Environment Act’s favourable conditions.

Requirements:

  • Professional writing skills to a high standard and verbal proficiency in English with minimum 2-3 years of experience working with multiple donors. This includes experience with proposal writing and reporting, preferably in the mine action, humanitarian and/or development sector.
  • Relevant higher education in project management, international development studies, international relations, business management, communications/media or similar, or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, time-sensitive activities and to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • You have experience with photography, photo and video editing, social media management and graphic design.

What you will do:

  • Coordinate and collate inputs from the Senior Management Team (SMT), Deputy Programme Managers (DPM), Project Manager (PjM), Admin/HR, Finance, Logistics, Information Management and Operations departments as part of reporting, concept notes and proposal writing.
  • Provide general support to the PM related to fundraising and donor engagement.
  • Monitor the implementation of, and compliance with, donor requirements on narrative reporting and communication.
  • Draft key documents as directed by the PM.
  • Act as the communication focal point for the programme.
  • Fulfil the role of climate and environment focal point within the programme.
  • Support the SMT with other tasks as directed by the PM.
  • Coordinate with the DPM based in Baghdad to ensure all the above responsibilities are always fulfilled.

Instructions for applying:

Please apply by the 19th of February 2024.

We continuously strive for more diversity and inclusion across the organisation. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply. You will hear from us within two weeks after the application deadline.

We kindly ask you to carefully read NPA’s Code of Conduct, Safeguarding Policy, and Anti-Corruption Policy before you submit your application. If you are the selected candidate for this position, you will be asked to complete and sign a Safeguarding self-declaration as well as our Code of Conduct.

Note: Validity of the offer and contract depends on satisfactory medical certificate, full vaccination, valid travel visa and necessary permits for service and residency in the country of service. The offer and contract also depend on donor funding and might be subject to donor approval.

title: Pharmacist
description:
Job Objectives


Provides pharmacy consulting services with empathy to patients regarding the effective usage of medications and awareness of drug interactions. Offers preventive and clinical healthcare services, including immunizations, diagnostic testing, and patient outcomes services. Responsible for ensuring the proper compounding, dispensation, review, and verification of prescribed medications within regulatory guidelines, company policies, and procedures. Supports the efficient workflow of the pharmacy and assists the pharmacy manager in identifying ways to optimize pharmacy financials, inventory management, and enhance the patient experience.

Job Responsibilities/Tasks


Patient Experience

  • Engages patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves patient issues in a timely manner and answers questions to ensure a positive patient experience.
  • Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and joyful experience, including interpersonal habits that show care (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., demonstrating curiosity to identify needs and proactively helping, servicing until satisfied, championing empathy and inclusivity, etc.).
  • Connects with patients by anticipating needs and proactively offering services. Supports efforts to enhance patient experience by increasing awareness of healthcare services offered through Walgreens (e.g., patient consultation, medication management, drug therapy reviews, and perform clinical or wellness services such as immunizations, diagnostic testing, and patient outcomes services), thereby promoting the shift of the Walgreens pharmacy role from transactional to interpersonal.
  • Participates and assists in events reflecting the communities served, as requested by Store Manager, Healthcare Supervisor, District Manager, or Pharmacy Manager.

Operations

  • Counsels patients and answers questions regarding medication usage, side effects, interactions, contraindications, patient information privacy, generics, less expensive medicines, over-the-counter products, and refers to medical providers as needed to ensure correct medication use and health needs are addressed.
  • Performs pharmacist tasks including compounding, drug therapy reviews, verification, and medication management.
  • Reviews, interprets, and accurately dispenses prescribed medications when workload necessitates.
  • Ensures pharmacy compliance with regulations, company policies, and standards. Assists pharmacy manager in establishing procedures that promote efficient workflow, including role assignment, activity coordination, and team input. Responsible for opening, closing, and shift change duties.
  • Ensures use of all elements of the Good Faith Dispensing policy in accordance with state and federal controlled substance laws when filling prescriptions. Responsible for ensuring that elements of Good Faith are present during product review and retail fill processes.
  • Maintains current knowledge of pharmacy IT systems related to workflow, prescription fulfillment, billing, clinical documentation, training, inventory management, and POS registers. Seeks improvements to promote productivity.
  • Ensures accurate processing of insurance claims, resolves patient issues, and prevents payment rejections. Follows up with insurance companies and medical providers; participates in third-party audits.
  • Follow-ups with medical providers to clarify prescriptions, dosages, refills, interactions, and allergies, suggesting alternatives and answering questions.
  • Performs clinical and wellness services such as immunizations, diagnostic testing, disease state management, and other healthcare services.
  • Assists in analyzing performance data related to pharmacy financials, customer service, and inventory management, supporting pharmacy asset protection and operational procedures.
  • Develops and maintains relationships with local healthcare providers and participates in community outreach to promote pharmacy services and growth.
  • Partners with centralized support for patient registration and issue resolution, including virtual product reviews following company protocols.

People & Performance Management

  • Assists in staff hiring and training, coaching, providing feedback, and monitoring customer service quality.
  • Promotes teamwork, motivates staff, sets expectations, and fosters a shared vision.

Training & Personal Development

  • Maintains required licenses, credentials, and certifications per regulations.
  • Keeps updated on pharmacy and healthcare developments through journals and company communications.
  • Obtains necessary certifications and training, including learning modules.
  • Seeks professional growth through performance monitoring, feedback, and mentorship.

Communications

  • Supports pharmacy and store management by communicating relevant health and wellness strategies to staff.

About Walgreens Boots Alliance


Walgreens Boots Alliance (Nasdaq: WBA) is a global healthcare, pharmacy, and retail leader serving millions daily, with a 175-year heritage. It operates approximately 12,500 locations across the U.S., Europe, and Latin America, focusing on dispensing medicines, healthcare access, high-quality products, and digital convenience. WBA employs around 312,000 people and owns brands like Walgreens, Boots, Duane Reade, No7 Beauty, and Benavides. More information is available at .

title: Producer
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCTION

What We Do

Whether it’s driving a vision from start to finish or collaborating with teams to inspire and deliver projects of Epic quality, Epic’s production teams take pride in consistently delivering world-class products and experiences.

What You'll Do

We are looking for an Art Producer to join us on the Fortnite Art team. In this position, you will be responsible for handling and organizing art tasks to help the artists do what they do best every day. Our team of producers focuses on guiding concepts from their nebulous creation through production execution and into implementation. This role will work across the art pipeline, partnering with many different teams. We are looking for individuals who excel in organization, have exceptional communication skills, and are comfortable managing schedules of complex projects. The ideal candidates are passionate about working in games, have a strong understanding of dependency-driven production methodologies, have a firm understanding of a 3D art creation pipeline, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

In this role, you will

  • Manage the Timeline - Partner with art discipline Leads and Art Directors to execute tasks against dependency-driven asset schedules to ensure the successful, on-time release of content that meets the Epic Art quality bar. Maintain Shotgrid scheduling, triage, and tracking.
  • Be the center of Communication - Facilitate constant communication with the art production team as well as cross-department production teams; providing transparency on asset status, risks, and opportunities. Ensure stakeholders have proper visibility into development and are informed of any changes that may impact their teams.
  • Proactively seek resolutions - Identify problems and propose solutions for your team, before they become roadblocks. Own the outcome of your area, and never wait to see if someone else will clear your path.
  • Be a flexible multitasker - Handle multiple large production needs within your development pod(s). Understand how to identify and break down prioritizations, and keep up strong communication across multiple outlets: email, Slack, meetings, and documentation.
  • Support all of your team’s production needs including, but not limited to; planning, scheduling; task tracking, and bug triage.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years of experience working in a production role managing cross-functional teams in the creation and delivery of complex projects.
  • Deep understanding of game development and project management practices.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience in an environment where you had to exhibit amazing problem-solving skills daily, viewing each new problem as an opportunity for success.
  • Self-starter who approaches challenges creatively and methodically, seeing them through to final resolution.
  • The ability to communicate with varying levels of stakeholders within your team and throughout the company.
  • Ability to drive high velocity, high impact development cycles while balancing out short-term needs and long-term vision.
  • Ability to adapt and be effective in ambiguous situations within a highly dynamic environment.
  • You’re passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

Experience driving culture and engagement initiatives, supporting change management efforts, and leveraging HR analytics for informed decision-making.

Isto é o que acontece na Cocamar: a cooperativa congrega cerca de 16 mil associados, em suas mais de 100 unidades operacionais espalhadas pelo norte e noroeste do Paraná, Oeste Paulista, Sudoeste do Mato Grosso do Sul e Centro-Oeste de Goiás.

Banco de Talentos para vagas de Motorista da Transcocamar.

MOTORISTA DE CARRETA: Viagens para entrega/coleta de produtos (graneleiro, varejo e commodities) para todo o Brasil, principalmente região Sul, Sudeste e Centro-oeste.

Atividades:

  • Atendimento aos clientes/cooperados/fornecedores nos locais de entrega/coleta;
  • Realizar entrega e coleta conforme normas da empresa;
  • Seguir os procedimentos de segurança e legislação conforme orientações;
  • Zelar pela higiene, boa conservação e manutenção do veículo.

MOTORISTA TRUCK: Responsável por guiar caminhões truck no transporte de cargas orgânicas ou inorgânicas, visando executar as atividades de acordo com o planejamento e roteiros predefinidos, observando as normas de trânsito e procedimentos internos.

  • Adotar os procedimentos necessários no caso de multas e sinistros, comunicando as ocorrências e provendo as informações e evidências necessárias;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme solicitação e orientações da liderança.

Curso MOPP;

Experiência na função.

title: LCA Lead | Life Cycle Analysis Lead
description:
About InPlanet

We are an impact-driven, remote-first, ClimateTech (CDR) startup headquartered in Germany and Brazil to reverse climate change and make tropical agriculture more regenerative, low-carbon, and sustainable. We are working with Enhanced Rock Weathering in tropical agriculture, focusing on Brazil. We do this to create a liveable planet for future generations and, specifically, to regenerate soils and ecosystems, grow nutritious food, and increase food security and sovereignty in the tropics.
People-first, Performance Culture: We believe that focus on people and performance can co-exist with the right cultural vision. Our philosophy is to blend these two essential components. The Rocket symbolizes our commitment to peak performance, excellence, and reaching new heights. The Heart represents our dedication to our people, fostering empathy, compassion, and genuine care for every team member's well-being.
We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are proud to have an internationally growing team and we are designing our people practices to serve psychological safety, belonging, and authenticity.

Key Responsibilities

LCA Development & Execution

  • Conduct full Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) for mining, rock sourcing, transportation, and field spreading processes .
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards , GHG Protocols, IPCC guidelines, and relevant carbon accounting frameworks .
  • Quantify the carbon footprint and co-benefits of InPlanet’s Enhanced Rock Weathering projects for emissions avoidance and reductions linked to changes in agronomic practices.

Scalability & Process Optimization

  • Develop scalable LCA methodologies to streamline assessment processes across multiple projects.
  • Integrate automation tools where possible to reduce manual data collection bottlenecks .
  • Identify opportunities for emissions reduction in our supply chain and propose actionable sustainability strategies.

Carbon Reporting & Certification

  • Produce Greenhouse Gas (GHG) statements and carbon accounting reports to support MRV (Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification) requirements .
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to align LCA outputs with carbon credit certification needs .

Stakeholder & Data Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with mines and supply chain partners to facilitate accurate and timely data collection.
  • Coordinate with farmers and supply chain teams to ensure high-quality input data .
  • Troubleshoot data gaps when mines or other partners do not provide necessary information (e.g. secondary mine process data).

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Work cross-functionally to ensure that LCA insights inform strategic decision-making at InPlanet.
  • Present findings to internal teams and external partners, communicating complex sustainability assessments in a clear and actionable manner .

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes.
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience with LCA methodologies and tools (e.g., SimaPro, OpenLCA, GaBi , or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with ISO 14040/14044 LCA standards and/or GHG accounting protocols .
  • 7+ years of experience in carbon accounting and sustainability impact assessments .
  • Knowledge of mining, agriculture, or supply chain sustainability is a strong plus.
  • Ability to structure LCAs for scalability in a fast-growing company.
Key Qualities
  • High attention to detail —accuracy in sustainability reporting is critical.
  • Solution-oriented mindset —doesn’t just point out gaps, but proposes fixes and optimisations.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Driven and resilient —pushes forward despite data collection challenges.
  • Comfortable with uncertainty —navigates the evolving landscape of carbon markets with adaptability.
Bonus Points (but not essential)
  • Certified LCA Practitioner (ACLCA)
  • Greenhouse Gas Accounting Certification (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064)
  • Certified Carbon Auditor
  • ISO 14040/14044 LCA Training

Benefits

  • Salary expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly. Competitive.
  • Share options (ESOP) to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 34+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference, and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

Location: Brazil (Preferably near São Paulo)
Languages: Fluent in Portuguese & English

At InPlanet, we are pioneering the use of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a scalable carbon removal solution. To ensure the credibility and scientific rigor of our impact, Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) plays a critical role in evaluating the full environmental footprint of our operations—from rock sourcing to CO₂ sequestration.
As our LCA Lead, you will spearhead the development and execution of LCAs for our ongoing and future projects. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Science, Operations, Carbon Accounting, and Business Development—to navigate complex sustainability frameworks, structure LCA methodologies for scalability, and produce reliable greenhouse gas (GHG) assessments that feed into our carbon credit issuance process.
This is a high-impact role at the core of our mission. If you're passionate about climate solutions and have a track record of data-driven sustainability analysis, we’d love to have you on board.

The Impact You Can Make

  • Develop and execute high-quality LCAs to quantify the environmental footprint of our supply chain, from rock mining to field application.
  • Establish scalable methodologies and refine LCA frameworks that can be applied efficiently across multiple geographies and project types.
  • Enable InPlanet to meet the strictest carbon market standards , ensuring credibility in the issuance of high-quality carbon removal credits.
  • Strengthen our network by building trust with mining and farming stakeholders , optimising data collection, and improving transparency.
  • Support the integration of LCA insights into business decisions , helping to shape strategic choices around material sourcing, transportation, and field deployment.

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.
The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.
These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 3-7 weeks from CV screening.

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • (optional third interview)
  • Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Potential in-person follow-up interview.
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How to Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

Being an equal opportunities employer is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

title: Eletrotécnico NOTURNO
description:
Descrição do Cargo:

O Eletrotécnico é responsável por realizar atividades relacionadas à instalação, manutenção e reparo de sistemas elétricos. Esses profissionais possuem conhecimentos técnicos em eletricidade e estão capacitados para trabalhar com circuitos elétricos, equipamentos e dispositivos elétricos. Abaixo estão algumas das principais responsabilidades desse cargo:

Responsabilidades:

  1. Instalação elétrica: Realizar a instalação de sistemas elétricos em edifícios, residências, indústrias e outras estruturas, seguindo normas e regulamentações técnicas. Isso inclui a instalação de fiação, cabos, painéis elétricos, disjuntores, tomadas e interruptores.
  2. Manutenção preventiva e corretiva: Executar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em sistemas elétricos para garantir o seu funcionamento adequado e a segurança dos usuários. Isso envolve a inspeção, limpeza, ajuste, reparo e substituição de componentes, como disjuntores, fusíveis, conexões e sistemas de aterramento.
  3. Diagnóstico de falhas: Identificar e diagnosticar problemas em sistemas elétricos por meio de testes, medições e análise técnica. Utilizar instrumentos de medição, como multímetros, para verificar a voltagem, corrente e resistência nos circuitos, a fim de localizar e solucionar falhas elétricas.
  4. Reparo e substituição de componentes: Realizar reparos e substituição de componentes elétricos defeituosos ou danificados, como interruptores, tomadas, lâmpadas, capacitores e motores. Isso pode envolver a desmontagem, reparo, substituição e montagem desses componentes.
  5. Manutenção de sistemas de iluminação: Realizar a manutenção de sistemas de iluminação, incluindo a troca de lâmpadas, reatores e luminárias. Verificar o correto funcionamento dos circuitos de iluminação, realizar medições de luminosidade e tomar medidas para otimizar o consumo de energia.
  6. Interpretação de projetos elétricos: Ler e interpretar projetos elétricos, diagramas e esquemas, para realizar as instalações e manutenções de acordo com as especificações técnicas.
  7. Cumprimento das normas de segurança: Assegurar que todas as atividades sejam realizadas em conformidade com as normas de segurança elétrica, garantindo a utilização adequada de equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e a aplicação de práticas seguras de trabalho.

Requisitos:

  • Formação técnica em Eletrotécnica, Eletrônica ou área relacionada.
  • NR10 E NR35
  • Residir em Niterói ou São Gonçalo
  • Experiência prévia comprovada como eletrotécnico ou em atividades similares.
  • Conhecimento em leitura e interpretação de projetos elétricos e diagramas.
  • Conhecimento das normas técnicas e regulamentações relacionadas à área elétrica.
  • Habilidades práticas em uso de ferramentas e equipamentos elétricos.
  • Capacidade de solucionar problemas e tomar decisões assertivas.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e em equipe.
  • Consciência e comprometimento com as normas de segurança elétrica.

Sobre a vaga:

  • Disponibilidade para escala 12X36 NOTURNO
  • Vale alimentação de R$17,50 por dia trabalhado
  • Salário + adicional noturno + 30% de periculosidade

Você conhece a Bunge?

Distribuída em mais de 40 países, líder mundial em processamento de oleaginosas e uma das maiores produtoras e fornecedoras de óleos, gorduras e proteínas vegetais há mais de dois séculos, a Bunge trabalha com o propósito de conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes e combustíveis essenciais para o mundo. Há 117 anos no Brasil, contamos com mais de 100 unidades e somos uma das principais empresas de agronegócio e alimentos, líder em originação de grãos e em processamento de soja e trigo. Em todas as nossas cadeias de valor promovemos nossos negócios de maneira sustentável ao mesmo tempo que apoiamos o bem-estar social e econômico das comunidades onde atuamos. Valorizamos a diversidade de nossos times e buscamos talentos criativos com espírito de equipe e vontade de fazer a diferença. Em tudo o que fazemos, colocamos em prática nossos valores:

Na Bunge, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e trabalhamos em prol de uma cultura inclusiva e de pertencimento, com respeito e equidade. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas como são!

Nossa empresa possui uma sólida trajetória e estamos construindo um futuro repleto de oportunidades! Faça parte de nosso time e venha trilhar sua jornada profissional com a gente.

Missão do Cargo

Como advogado(a) nesta posição, você fornecerá suporte jurídico especializado e estratégico, essencial para nossas iniciativas em sustentabilidade e direitos humanos, atuando com questões socioambientais, alavancando nossas iniciativas de impacto positivo.

Atividades e Responsabilidades

Consultoria Jurídica:

  • Análise de instrumentos jurídicos relacionados a projetos socioambientais, tais como contratos, termos de compromisso, etc..

Contencioso:

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Elaboração de relatórios de due diligence em direitos humanos e sustentabilidade.

Outras atividades:

  • Elaboração de contratos, declarações e outros instrumentos jurídicos, tais como (exemplos: contratos com cláusulas socioambientais, códigos de conduta, etc.).
  • Participação em grupos de trabalho de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos, internos e externos, interagindo com diferentes stakeholders.
  • Prover treinamentos às áreas de interface.

Impacto/Dimensão

O(A) Advogado(a) de Sustentabilidade e Direitos Humanos desempenha um papel estratégico na mitigação de riscos e na geração de valor para a empresa, contribuindo diretamente para:

  • Redução de passivos ambientais e sociais: Através da análise criteriosa de documentos e da emissão de pareceres jurídicos, o(a) profissional contribui para a prevenção de multas e processos judiciais, gerando uma economia à empresa.

Isso envolve a análise de diversos documentos por ano e a emissão de pareceres que subsidiam decisões estratégicas à área de originação, sustentabilidade e direitos humanos.

Isso inclui a participação em diversos projetos por ano, com alcance nacional e internacional, e a interação com diferentes stakeholders.

Langan is seeking an entry-level Highway / Roadway Engineer to join its collaborative team in Doylestown, PA . This individual will serve a key function in the engineering design of highway, freeways and local roads for diversified transportation projects across the Northeast and across the country. In this role, under the direction of a Senior Engineer, you will have the opportunity to assist with the design and permitting of traffic/transportation engineering and infrastructure projects in a cross-disciplinary learning environment.

  1. Geometric designs of highways, freeways and local roads using national and local codes;

  10. Complete ADA inspections of constructed facilities; and
  11. Perform other duties as requested.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering;
  2. 0-2 years of work-related experience;

  4. Prior related internship or professional experience;
  5. Knowledge and Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D and MS Office;
  6. Knowledge of Guidesign, AutoTURN, and MicroStation;
  7. Familiarity with CalTrans, AASHTO, and MUTCD standards;
  8. Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  9. Strong attention to detail with excellent analytical, multitasking, and judgment capabilities;
  10. Ability to effectively work independently and in a team environment; and
  11. Possess reliable transportation for client meetings and job site visits, and a valid driver's license in good standing.

Langan is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. We believe that an inclusive workplace is essential for the well-being and success of our employees.

  1. Planejar as aulas a serem ministradas, consultando a apostila contendo o programa que serve como norteador, participando dos encontros semanais com a coordenação, montando suas atividades, para definir as melhores estratégias do desenvolvimento do conteúdo e definição de prioridades.

  4. Avaliar o processo e o aprendizado do aluno – semanalmente, revendo o que foi planejado, resultados alcançados e a devolutiva dos alunos, para dar continuidade ao processo.
  5. Preparar, aplicar e corrigir provas de aproveitamento de aprendizagem, elaborando as provas através do conteúdo que foi ministrado, para verificar o grau de aproveitamento.
  6. Atender pais em reuniões bimestrais e a qualquer momento necessário, ouvindo e orientando os pais junto com a coordenação, para nortear o trabalho com cada aluno em particular.
  7. Elaborar relatórios em casos especiais, redigindo com a coordenação e encaminhando para profissionais de outras áreas (psicólogo, fonoaudiólogo), para ter uma visão global do aluno e poder adotar procedimentos de acordo com as características de cada caso.

  9. Participar de curso de tecnologia em sala de aula, tratando de assuntos gerais do colégio, assistindo on-line e realizando lições, para atualizar e melhorar o uso da tecnologia.
  10. Trocar informações com Psicólogos, Fonoaudiólogos, Terapeutas Ocupacionais, analisando as percepções, obtendo indicações de tratamento, para melhorar o atendimento às necessidades especiais de alguns alunos.

  • Geração de Relatórios e Ações de Melhoria Contínua
    • Mensurar resultados (custo por lead, conversão, LTV, ROI de campanhas) e elaborar relatórios com recomendações estratégicas para fóruns de estratégia e lideranças.

description:
O que você fará:

Como Analista de Desenvolvimento de Produto, você desfrutará de uma equipe global na primeira linha na definição do Consumer Experience Lab no caminho para desenvolver produtos relacionados a categorias de preparação de alimentos. O Analista será responsável pela elaboração, execução, análise e documentação de testes de laboratório em produtos de Preparação de Alimentos. A maior parte do trabalho será em torno da introdução de novos produtos, mas também pode incluir iniciativas de ECI e melhoria de qualidade.

Em detalhes, você irá:

  • Realizar validação, desenvolvimento e testes seguindo normas internacionais e Manuais de Testes internos;

  • Realizar solução de problemas e análise de causa raiz em estreita colaboração com os departamentos de P&D e Qualidade para melhorar continuamente nossa experiência do consumidor;
  • Garantir o alinhamento das metodologias de teste com outros laboratórios e institutos de teste relevantes;
  • Colaborar com parceiros de negócios, como universidades e laboratórios externos, para encontrar ou desenvolver novos recursos e produtos.

Quem você é:

  • Experiência com metodologias de teste (DOE, metodologias estatísticas ou relacionadas);
  • Conhecimento de equipamentos de laboratório, sistema de aquisição de dados, procedimentos de teste e métodos de análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento de componentes elétricos/eletrônicos;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de laboratório elétrico, de gás, MWO e execução de testes;
  • Habilidades avançadas de Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Project);

Job Title: Customer Success Account Manager (Brazil)
Location: Brazil (hybrid)
Team: B2B – Customer Success & Account Management

About Cambly

Cambly is a fast-growing EdTech company on a mission to make English learning accessible to students around the world through live, one-on-one conversations with native speakers. As we expand our B2B footprint in Brazil, we’re looking for a Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM) to own the full post-sales experience—from onboarding and platform engagement to account renewals and upsells.

This is a hybrid role that combines Customer Success and Account Management responsibilities to provide strategic and hands-on support for a portfolio of B2B clients in Brazil.

Why This Role?

We’re combining CS + AM functions in select markets like Brazil due to:

  • A relatively small and manageable customer base

  • Low deal complexity

  • Budget and resource efficiency

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-facing environment and wants end-to-end ownership of client success and retention.

What You’ll Do

  • Guide onboarding and adoption : Lead platform setup for admins and learners to ensure a quick time-to-value.

  • Account segmentation and strategy : Segment accounts by revenue potential and create targeted engagement strategies.

  • Drive engagement and outcomes : Monitor usage, conduct quarterly business reviews, celebrate learner milestones, and ensure platform value is being realized.

  • Support and communication : Be the go-to contact for admin requests and ensure timely, solution-oriented support.

  • Monitor account health : Provide regular usage and performance reports to support internal advocacy within client organizations.

  • Satisfaction tracking : Run student and admin satisfaction surveys to collect feedback and inform future improvements.

  • Renewals and upsells : Own renewal conversations and identify opportunities for account growth through upsells.

  • CRM management : Keep HubSpot and internal CRM tools updated with accurate client data, engagement activities, and renewal forecasts.

  • Performance tracking : Track and report against key KPIs such as platform utilization, satisfaction, renewal rates, and upsell performance.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success and/or Account Management , with a strong track record of client retention and renewal success in a B2B setting.

  • Demonstrated ability to articulate product value , manage account health, and lead strategic client conversations.

  • Comfortable with data analysis , CRM hygiene, and using metrics to drive decisions.

  • Skilled in presenting to stakeholders , conducting QBRs, and managing multiple accounts in a structured way.

  • Fluent in Portuguese and proficient in English (spoken and written).

  • Highly organized, proactive, and client-centric .

  • Must be based in Brazil and familiar with the local business and education landscape.

Why Cambly?

  • A global, mission-driven team making a meaningful impact on learners worldwide

  • Pre-IPO company with high growth and equity opportunities

  • Ownership and autonomy in a cross-functional, collaborative culture

  • Chance to grow your career with a company expanding its B2B presence in Brazil

O cargo de Social Media é uma função essencial no cenário digital atual. Este profissional é responsável por gerenciar e alimentar as redes sociais de uma empresa, marca ou personalidade, criando conteúdo relevante, interagindo com o público e monitorando os resultados.

Descrição do cargo:

O Social Media planeja, cria e executa estratégias de conteúdo para as redes sociais, buscando construir uma imagem positiva da marca, engajar o público-alvo e gerar resultados para o negócio. É necessário ter conhecimento sobre diferentes plataformas, suas funcionalidades e algoritmos, além de estar sempre atualizado sobre tendências e novidades do mundo digital.

  • Organização e criatividade para manter um calendário ativo

As atividades de um Social Media podem variar dependendo do tamanho da empresa e suas necessidades, mas geralmente incluem:

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.

Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

Jeeves is rapidly growing their operations in Brazil and searching for a motivated, ambitious Sales Development Representative to join and help scale our Brazil sales organization. The Sales Development Representative will report to our Country Manager in Brazil, and be responsible for closing high-value clients and growing the Brazilian market. We are in need of driven sales professionals to focus on generating qualified prospects via a multi-channel approach using AI tools, email, WhatsApp, cold calls, events, and channel partners. This position is both hands-on and strategic as they will act in a critical role for Jeeves as the hunter of new business opportunities.

Location: This role is based out of São Paulo, Brazil , and is a full-time position where it is required to come into our office in the Faria Lima area. #LI-Hybrid


Job Responsibilities:
  • Prospecting and Lead Generation : Identify and research potential clients, focusing on those who could benefit from the company's products or services. Use various tools and platforms to generate a steady pipeline of high-quality leads.
  • Outbound Sales Efforts : Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to connect with potential clients. Use personalized messaging to engage prospects and set up introductory meetings.
  • Qualification of Leads : Assess the needs and challenges of prospective clients to determine if they align with the company's solutions. Qualify leads based on specific criteria such as budget, authority, need, and timeline (BANT).
  • CRM Management : Maintain accurate and up-to-date information on all leads and prospects within the company's CRM system. Track interactions, follow-ups, and the progression of leads through the sales funnel.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams : Work closely with Account Executives and other sales team members to ensure a smooth handoff of qualified leads. Provide detailed insights and context about each lead to facilitate successful conversions.
  • Market and Industry Research : Stay informed about trends, challenges, and opportunities in the fintech industry. Use this knowledge to tailor outreach strategies and provide relevant information to potential clients.
  • Performance Tracking and Reporting : Regularly track and report on key performance metrics, such as the number of leads generated, outreach efforts, and conversion rates. Use this data to refine strategies and improve results.
  • Participation in Sales and Marketing Campaigns : Assist in the planning and execution of targeted sales and marketing campaigns. Provide feedback on messaging and content effectiveness based on interactions with prospects.
  • Continuous Learning and Development : Stay up-to-date with the company’s products, services, and value propositions. Participate in ongoing training and development to improve sales skills and industry knowledge.
  • Customer Feedback Loop : Gather feedback from prospects and clients about the company's offerings and share insights with the product and marketing teams to help refine and improve products and services.
Experience:
  • Sales Experience : 3+ years of experience in a sales or customer-facing role, preferably in the fintech, finance, or technology industry.
  • Fluent in English : Jeeves is a global company and English is the language we use internally to communicate between regions.
  • Experience in Lead Generation : Proven experience in prospecting, lead generation, and lead qualification. Familiarity with sales methodologies like BANT (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline) or similar frameworks is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Prospecting Tools : Experience using various prospecting tools and platforms, such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar tools to identify and engage with potential clients.
  • CRM Proficiency : Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar platforms.
Skills:
  • Excellent Communication Skills : Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to craft personalized and persuasive messages to engage potential clients.
  • Analytical Skills : Ability to analyze market data, understand industry trends, and identify opportunities for lead generation.
  • Time Management : Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.
  • Tech-Savvy : Comfortable using various sales and marketing tools, such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, email automation platforms, and other lead generation tools.
  • Problem-Solving Skills : Ability to think critically and creatively to overcome objections and find solutions that meet the needs of potential clients.
  • Innovative Prospecting : Demonstrated ability to develop and implement innovative strategies for prospecting and lead generation, thinking outside the box to identify new opportunities.
  • Resilience and Persistence : Ability to handle rejection and maintain a positive attitude. Demonstrates persistence and determination to achieve goals.
Industry Knowledge:
  • Understanding of Fintech : Familiarity with the fintech industry, including knowledge of financial products, services, and industry challenges. A passion for technology and innovation in finance is a plus.
Personal Attributes:
  • Customer-Centric Mindset : Strong focus on understanding customer needs and delivering value through the company's offerings.
  • Team Player : Ability to work collaboratively with other members of the sales team, as well as with marketing and product teams.
  • Continuous Learning : Willingness to learn and adapt to new sales techniques, industry developments, and company products/services.

title: Tech Lead
description:
Description

Summary:

We are looking for a Tech Lead to join our growing cross-functional Engineering team (Individual Marketplace) and build out the next generation of health insurance marketplace products. Colleagues will need to draw from your technical knowledge, research abilities, and problem-solving skills. The candidate will be a leader who motivates and coaches a team to deliver results that drive measurable business impact. Ultimately, the successful candidate will play a key role in creating software that helps our customers make critically important health care decisions with confidence.

Role:

We are looking for a Tech Lead to join our team. You should value expertise and a passion for the craft of Software Engineering. You should be able to recognize and stay up to date on current techniques and tools, but also be prudent in knowing what is and isn’t a good fit.

Key Responsibilities:
  • The candidate will be in a pivotal role, acting as the bridge between the architecture practice team and the respective dev team to adhere to architecture principles and best practices.
  • Be a dedicated mentor for a cross-functional team consisting of software and database engineers based in different locations.
  • Conduct one-on-one coaching sessions with team members to assist in their career development.
  • Unblock team members with technical roadblocks.
  • Support in building software primarily using C# on .NET and/or .NET Core, along with MS-SQL (T-SQL), React.js, targeting Azure native solutions.
  • The candidate should be well aware of Azure PaaS services and related best practices and patterns.
  • Design database changes and programming patterns.
  • Perform code reviews.
  • Work closely with Product Management to represent the technical challenges of your application.
  • Encourage research and experimentation within the team to find the best technology solutions.
  • Facilitate the vision of management, and represent the team to management.
  • Assist with interviewing new candidates as needed.
  • Work with cross-functional disciplines such as UX, Product Management, and Systems Engineering.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • B.E., B.Tech, or MCA with a minimum of 10+ years of experience in Software Development.
  • Experience collaborating with and uniting remote team members.
  • Hands-on experience with C#, including modern web frameworks like ASP.NET Core Web API, ASP.NET Web Forms, ASP.NET MVC, etc.
  • Experience with MS SQL Server, including data modeling, data governance, and ETLs.
  • Hands-on experience with modern software design and development patterns.
  • Experience handling Azure PaaS services to build Azure native solutions.
  • Experience with ReactJS is a plus.
  • Experience with CI/CD practices; familiarity with Github and Github Actions is a plus.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies.
  • Familiarity with API design, microservices, and messaging patterns.
  • Knowledge of indicators that define a high-functioning team.
  • Ability to accept ownership of work and overall projects.
  • Good communication skills, both in sharing ideas and listening to others.
  • Availability for flexible work schedules to overlap with US onshore teams.
